decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w5' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.8909. Series context: trend strength 0.9993 and seasonal strength 0.9999; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.127); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.215.
